'''Cold Beam''' is a [[debuff]] from the [[totem]]s summon by [[High Templar Dominus]] and his map variants: [[God's Chosen]] and [[The High Templar]]. The skill ids are ranged from "[[Skill:DominusChillingBond|DominusChillingBond]]" to "[[Skill:DominusChillingBond4|DominusChillingBond4]]".

As the internal id "'''Chilling Bond'''" indicated, it is a cold version of {{il|Searing Bond}} but the beam would not link to Dominus himself. 

Cold Beam is the official name of this skill which used in the status icon and in a [[List of heist league challenges|league challenge]].

The summoned totem has no name, only the generic name "Totem" is shown in the nameplate.

The following list is auto-generated by cargo query for any monster that use the skill that contains the word "ChillingBond":
